tasks.subject: Task 1: Backend — ?subproject= on products repos endpoint
tasks.description:
**Goal:** GET /api/products/ppg/{version}/repos?subproject=extras returns only extras repos; invalid param → 400.

**Files:** backend/internal/api/handlers.go, backend/internal/api/handlers_test.go

**Acceptance Criteria:** ?subproject=extras narrows prefix to :extras; absent param unchanged; invalid param → 400; existing repos tests pass.

**Verify:** cd backend && go test ./internal/api/ -run TestRepos -v && go test ./...

tasks.subject: Task 2: Frontend — Context model + PPG Extras entry + URL key
tasks.description:

**Files:** frontend/src/types/api.ts, frontend/src/lib/contexts.ts, frontend/src/App.vue, frontend/src/composables/useUrlState.ts

**Acceptance Criteria:** Context gains subproject/allowedSubprojects; PPG allowlist ['containers']; PPG_EXTRAS_CONTEXT subproject 'extras'; selector [PPG, PPG Extras, Releases, ...PRs]; contextToKey ppg-extras; npm run build passes.
